one_line: Brahmavādinī of the early Upanishadic age, whose questioning sparks Yājñavalkya’s teaching on the Self.

appearance.age_look: Appears in her mid-20s, slender but sturdy build, with the calm poise of a serious student and a subtle athletic grace from daily ritual duties.
appearance.face: Oval face with soft but defined jaw, warm medium-brown complexion, straight nose, full but firm-set lips, large thoughtful almond-shaped eyes with dark irises and a steady, questioning gaze; a small tilaka of sandalwood paste on the forehead; default expression is composed and attentive, with brows slightly knit in inquiry rather than aggression.
appearance.hair: Long, straight, dark brown-black hair oiled smooth, parted in the middle and drawn back into a single thick braid reaching to mid-back; the braid is wrapped near the base with a narrow reddish-brown cloth band and finished with a small cluster of plain white flowers at the end; no crown or metal headpiece, only a simple thin off-white cloth hairband tied above the ears to keep loose strands back.
appearance.costume: Era-appropriate early Vedic household attire: a full-length off-white cotton sari-like draped garment (unstitched, simple weave) wrapped securely around the waist, falling to the ankles, with soft vertical folds; the upper end is brought over the left shoulder as a modest pallu that covers the torso fully and can be pulled farther up when she sits to study; underneath, a muted ochre-brown sleeveless inner tunic peeks at the neck and shoulders, keeping everything fully covered; she wears a simple narrow dark-brown cloth girdle at the waist; jewelry is restrained: small round copper-colored ear studs, a single thin bronze bangle on each wrist, and a plain black-thread necklace with one tiny copper bead; her feet are in simple brown leather sandals with a toe loop, appropriate to a learned household rather than a warrior; no extravagant patterns, just subtle handloom texture with a narrow dull-indigo border running along the sari’s edge.
appearance.signature: A palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with a thin cord and a single stylus: several narrow, light-brown palm leaves bound together in the left hand or resting in her lap, with a simple wooden writing stylus tucked under the cord, symbolizing her role as a questioning student and transmitter of teaching.

ref_desc: Maitreyi is a mid-20s, medium-brown skinned woman with an oval face, large thoughtful dark eyes, a sandalwood tilaka, long dark hair in a single mid-back braid with a cloth band and white flowers, wearing an off-white early Vedic sari with dull-indigo border over an ochre-brown inner tunic, simple bronze and thread jewelry, brown sandals, and carrying a bound palm-leaf manuscript bundle with a wooden stylus.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Maitreyi from the early Upanishadic age: a dignified young woman in her mid-20s with an oval face, warm medium-brown complexion, straight nose, full lips, and large thoughtful almond eyes, marked by a small sandalwood tilaka on her forehead and a calm, questioning expression. Her long dark brown-black hair is oiled smooth, parted in the middle, gathered into a single thick braid to mid-back, secured near the base with a narrow reddish-brown cloth band and finished with a small cluster of plain white flowers, with a thin off-white cloth hairband tied above the ears. She wears a historically grounded early Vedic outfit: a full-length off-white cotton sari-like draped garment with subtle handloom texture and a narrow dull-indigo border, wrapped around the waist to the ankles and brought over the left shoulder as a modest pallu that fully covers her torso, over a simple ochre-brown sleeveless inner tunic visible at the neckline; a narrow dark-brown cloth girdle ties at the waist. Add minimal jewelry: small round copper-colored ear studs, one thin bronze bangle on each wrist, and a plain black-thread necklace with a single tiny copper bead. Her feet are in simple brown leather sandals with a toe loop. In one hand, she firmly holds a bound palm-leaf manuscript bundle made of several light-brown leaves tied with a cord, with a simple wooden stylus tucked under the binding, posed as a focused philosophical inquirer; show front, side, and back views, keeping all garments modest and fully covering the body, and emphasize the off-white, ochre brown, dark brown, dull indigo, and warm medium-brown color palette.
